sources.title: Rodin AI — Rodin Gen-2.5 3D Model Generator
sources.snippet: Generate 3D models from text or images with Rodin AI. Rodin Gen-2.5 delivers 5 quality tiers, up to 2M polygons, HD PBR textures, and GLB/FBX/OBJ export — free to try.

sources.title: Free AI 3D Model Generator - MeshGPT
sources.snippet: Create stunning 3D models from text or images instantly with our free AI 3d model generator. Transform your ideas into production-ready 3D assets with MeshGPT.

sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Modly generates 3D meshes from your photos or a text prompt using open-source AI models. All locally, unlimited and completely free.

sources.title: AI 3D Model Generator: Create 3D from Text & Images | Meshy
sources.snippet: Meshy's AI 3D model generator turns text and images into production-ready 3D models in 20-30 seconds. Export to FBX, OBJ, GLB, and STL formats. Try Meshy free.

sources.title: AI Models | Civitai
sources.snippet: Browse thousands of free Stable Diffusion & Flux models, LoRAs, checkpoints, and embeddings. The largest collection of AI image generation resources.
